title: At the Limits of Computability: Steps Towards Autonomous AI Discovery on the Busy Beaver Frontier
abstract: arXiv:2610.22603v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent breakthroughs in AI for mathematics---ranging from Olympiad medal performances to resolving long-standing open conjectures---have rapidly expanded what automated systems can achieve. Yet these successes primarily concern predefined, human-formulated problems, leaving open how AI systems can autonomously uncover mathematical structure and formulate new questions. To push beyond static challenges, we explore the Busy Beaver (BB) domain, an uncomputable frontier that is fundamentally open-ended. Because no algorithm can compute the Busy Beaver number $\mathrm{BB}(n)$ for every $n$, this domain provides a natural setting for sustained exploration through mathematical conjecture and proof. In this paper, we introduce a Gemini-based agentic pipeline that automatically discovers accelerations of Turing machines, expressed as compact mathematical rules summarizing many execution steps. translated_title: 在可计算性的极限处：迈向忙碌海狸前沿上自主AI发现的步伐
translated_abstract: 近来数学AI领域的突破——从获得奥林匹克竞赛奖牌到解决长期悬而未决的猜想——迅速拓展了自动化系统所能达到的成就。然而，这些成功主要局限于预先定义的、由人类构建的问题，AI系统如何自主地揭示数学结构并提出新问题仍是未解难题。为了超越静态挑战，我们探索忙碌海狸（Busy Beaver, BB）领域，一个本质上开放、不可计算的前沿。由于没有任何算法能够对所有n计算出忙碌海狸数BB(n)，该领域为通过数学猜想与证明进行持续探索提供了天然场景。在本文中，我们提出了一个基于Gemini的智能体流水线，能够自动发现图灵机的加速方法，并将其表达为概括大量执行步骤的简洁数学规则。我们的系统集成了模式识别、自动化……（原文摘要在此处中断）
tldr: 本文提出一个基于Gemini的智能体流水线，在不可计算的忙碌海狸前沿上自主发现图灵机加速规则，标志着AI向自主数学发现迈出了重要一步。
